title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the commercial corridors and historic streets surrounding DePaul's Lincoln Park and Loop campuses, from boutique-lined avenues to the heart of the business district.

cards.title: Armitage Avenue
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Park Shopping Corridor
cards.notes: Walk east from campus to browse high-end boutiques and local shops that often offer student discounts with a valid DePaul ID.
cards.short_summary: A trendy commercial street east of the Lincoln Park campus known for upscale retail and student-friendly discounts.
cards.evidence_claim: DePaul students receive discounts at various retailers on Armitage Avenue, such as 15 percent off at certain clothing stores when presenting their ID.
cards.source_title: DePaul discounts: a days worth of student disscounts around Lincoln Park - The DePaulia
cards.access_notes: Public city street accessible 24/7; individual shop hours vary.

cards.title: Fullerton Avenue
cards.subtitle: Main Campus Thoroughfare
cards.notes: Navigate this central artery to reach the Ray Meyer Fitness Center or grab a quick bite at the various quick-service eateries near the 'L' station.
cards.short_summary: The primary east-west street bisecting the Lincoln Park campus, home to major university facilities and transit links.
cards.evidence_claim: Fullerton Avenue serves as a main access point for the Lincoln Park campus, housing the Ray Meyer Fitness Center and connecting to the Fullerton CTA station.
cards.source_title: Lincoln Park Campus - Chicago, IL - DePaul University
cards.access_notes: Major public thoroughfare; high pedestrian traffic during class hours.

cards.title: State Street
cards.subtitle: Loop Campus Retail Hub
cards.notes: Visit the historic DePaul Center or walk south to the University Center residence hall located along this iconic downtown corridor.
cards.short_summary: A major north-south street in the Loop that hosts DePaul's downtown academic buildings and student housing.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Center residence hall and the DePaul Center are located on State Street, placing students in the heart of the Loop's retail district.
cards.source_title: Loop Housing Options - DePaul University, Chicago
cards.access_notes: Public downtown street; DePaul buildings require ID for entry.

cards.title: Halsted Street
cards.subtitle: Dining and Entertainment Row
cards.notes: Head two blocks east of the Quad to find a dense concentration of restaurants and cafes popular for off-campus group dinners.
cards.short_summary: A vibrant north-south street east of the Lincoln Park campus featuring numerous dining options and local businesses.
cards.evidence_claim: Halsted Street is a primary commercial corridor near the Lincoln Park campus, cited as a destination for students seeking dining and retail options.
cards.source_title: Lincoln Park Campus - Chicago, IL - DePaul University
cards.access_notes: Public street; most businesses are open late into the evening.

cards.title: Jackson Boulevard
cards.subtitle: Loop Academic Corridor
cards.notes: Walk between the DePaul Center and the Daley Building along this street, which serves as the main east-west axis for the Loop campus.
cards.short_summary: The central street for DePaul's Loop campus, connecting major academic buildings and transit hubs.
cards.evidence_claim: The Loop Campus is centered on Jackson Boulevard at State Street, with the DePaul Center located at 1 E. Jackson Blvd.
cards.source_title: Loop Campus - Chicago, IL - DePaul University
cards.access_notes: Public street; high traffic area in the central business district.

cards.title: Webster Avenue
cards.subtitle: Quiet Residential & Cafe Street
cards.notes: Stroll past historic townhomes to reach local favorites like Jam 'N Honey for a weekend brunch just steps from the residence halls.
cards.short_summary: A scenic street south of the main campus quad known for its residential charm and local eateries.
cards.evidence_claim: Webster Avenue is home to student-frequented spots like Jam 'N Honey and is described as a homey street with interesting shops.
cards.source_title: An Inside Look at Lincoln Park's Beautiful Neighborhood - DePaul University Blogs
cards.access_notes: Public residential street; very walkable and well-lit.

cards.title: Wabash Avenue
cards.subtitle: The 'L' Tracks Corridor
cards.notes: Walk under the elevated train tracks to access the CDM Center or find quick lunch spots catering to the downtown student crowd.
cards.short_summary: A street in the Loop campus area characterized by the overhead 'L' tracks and proximity to digital media facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The CDM Center and other Loop campus buildings are located near Wabash Avenue, which is a key transit and commercial corridor.
cards.source_title: Loop Campus - Chicago, IL - DePaul University
cards.access_notes: Public street; features the Adams/Wabash CTA station nearby.

cards.title: Sheffield Avenue
cards.subtitle: Campus Activity Spine
cards.notes: Follow this street to move between the Student Center and the athletic fields, passing several university-owned apartment buildings.
cards.short_summary: The primary north-south street running through the heart of the Lincoln Park campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Sheffield Avenue is the location of the Lincoln Park Student Center and several residence halls like Sheffield Square.
cards.access_notes: Public street with heavy university presence; pedestrian-friendly.

cards.title: Lincoln Avenue
cards.subtitle: Diagonal Neighborhood Link
cards.notes: Explore the diagonal stretch northwest of campus to find local bookstores and independent cafes that define the neighborhood's character.
cards.short_summary: A major diagonal street near the Lincoln Park campus offering a mix of retail and dining.
cards.evidence_claim: Lincoln Avenue is noted as a nearby commercial area where students can find local bookstores, boutiques, and restaurants.
cards.source_title: Lincoln Park Campus - Chicago, IL - DePaul University
cards.access_notes: Public diagonal street; connects the campus to the broader Lincoln Park neighborhood.

cards.title: Belden Avenue
cards.subtitle: Historic Residential Block
cards.notes: Walk east toward the park to see the historic Belden-Stratford building and enjoy the quieter, tree-lined side of the neighborhood.
cards.short_summary: A residential street north of the Quad known for its historic architecture and proximity to the park.
cards.evidence_claim: Belden Avenue features iconic buildings like the Belden-Stratford and provides a scenic, walkable route near the university.
cards.source_title: The Best Apartment Buildings Near DePaul University in Lincoln Park - Fulton Grace Realty
cards.access_notes: Public residential street; quiet and scenic.
